title: Write It on My Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Long, long ago on mountain stone
The law was carved so plain;
The people read it with their eyes,
But hearts went wrong again.

[Chorus]
Oh, write it on my heart, dear Lord,
Where no one else can see;
So when I'm all alone I'll know
Your good way lives in me.

[Verse 2]
Then Jeremiah heard Him say,
"A brand-new promise, true:
I'll write My law inside their hearts,
And they will know Me too."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
From littlest child to biggest one,
Yes, every one would know;
And Jesus came to bring that gift
So many years ago.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When nobody is watching me,
I'll choose the good and true;
His goodness, written on my heart,
Goes with me all day through.

[Chorus]
mood: Tracing music. A slow, even pulse under the voice, like one finger drawing a single line across a chest, unhurried and sure. Soft felt piano in slow chords, with one high note now and then like a pen touching paper. Inward rather than sad, and a little surer with every verse, as if the words are settling where they belong.
